symptom: Re-executing a microflow with `$V = import from mapping M.Import_mapping($latestHttpResponse);` whose mapping is built on a web service operation: mx check "The selected import mapping cannot handle content type JSON." Opening the activity in Studio Pro fixes it: "This action now imports XML"
cause: `importXmlActionToGen` (and the REST mapping result handling in `restResultHandlingToGen`) wrote `ImportMappingCall.ContentType` as the constant "Json"; the reader never read it, so even a pass-through rewrite of a stored XML import turned it into JSON
insight: The content type is a property of the MAPPING's source (XML schema or web service → Xml, JSON structure → Json), which the builder already fetches for the result entity — derive it there, and carry the stored value on read so a rewrite never re-derives what it cannot see. `call web service` already wrote Xml (microflow_webservice_write.go); grep `"ContentType", "Json"` for any other constant. Not run against mxbuild: MDL cannot author an XML schema or WSDL import and no testdata fixture has a mapping built on one (grep for `ImportedWebService` in mprcontents finds none) — the reporter's mx check on 11.12.4 is the evidence that Json is refused. Message-definition mappings stay Json, unmeasured
